name: ApprovalConditionsTracker
tagline: Many approvals are given subject to conditions - "approved, provided three quotes are obtained", "pay only after the signed contract is on file".
description: Many approvals are given subject to conditions - "approved, provided three quotes are obtained", "pay only after the signed contract is on file". The Approval Conditions Tracker keeps those conditions on the approved record and follows each one to closure: who owns it, when it is due, what evidence was provided and who verified it.
features: Each condition has a category, owner, due date
Shows a release gate (Blocked / Clear), progress
Overdue and due-soon counts, KPI filters, search
Grouping by category or owner, sorting
A validated add/edit form with templates
A start / submit evidence / verify / waive / reopen workflow with segregation of duties and a per-condition history
